primary_sources.paper_claim_vs_derived: The paper states the classical/efficient-adversary generalized RTLWE-to-LWE theorem. The QPT classical-query lift is derived in Run 94 and is not attributed to the authors.
primary_sources.title: Multi-Authority ABE from Lattices without Random Oracles

research_result.negative: For the subset-policy identity-selector mapping, the RTLWE full-rank gate is exactly the unauthorized-set condition. Clear public same-binding ABE key-component prepublication sufficient for an authorized set exposes a witness-free decryption key; independent bindings do not satisfy the core single-r cancellation identity in general.
research_result.positive: Derived QPT lift of Waters-Wee-Wu generalized related-trapdoor LWE for QPT adversaries with arbitrary quantum state but only classical preimage queries/static classical auxiliary views, conditional on QPT hardness of the exact LWE distribution used in their Lemma 4.5/Theorem 4.2 and their statistical parameter conditions.
research_result.scope: Does not prove coherent-superposition preimage-oracle security, generic-NP source capability, full-output QPT hiding, arbitrary-QPT source extraction, or a completed WKEM.
